description: A dim, cluttered laboratory with a candle, shelves of glassware and scientific apparatus. A man in a waistcoat and shirtsleeves swings a hammer at a steel bar hanging from the ceiling, while a second man stands in shadow behind him. In the foreground a crying, light-haired toddler in a white romper stands on a mattress with arms outstretched, and a small white rat sits on the mattress at lower left. Oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge with no visible text.
